facts.text: The hotel sits behind the facades of two 19th-century palazzos.
facts.excerpt: Behind the façades of two 19th-century palazzos, W Rome's guestrooms offer a contemporary take on the Eternal City's design heritage.

facts.text: The hotel's address is 26/36 Via Liguria, Rome.

facts.text: Piazza di Spagna, the Trevi Fountain, the Pantheon and Piazza Navona are within a stroll of the hotel.

facts.text: Guestrooms are inspired by Italian design icons Carlo Scarpa and Ettore Sottsass.
